preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 2^16 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= degree[i] <= n - 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each degreei is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= si < 2**16 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each si is between 0 and 2^16 exclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of edges m is half the sum of all degrees.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) has vertices a and b between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) connects two distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(degree[i] == sum(1 for a, b in edges if i in (a, b)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The degree of each vertex i matches the number of edges connected to it.

postconditions.expression: all(si == sum(j for a, b in edges if i in (a, b) for j in (a, b) if j != i) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The XOR sum si of each vertex i matches the XOR of its adjacent vertices.
